name: FoodChain
tagline: Watches public signals for food-security crises and plans responses for a food-bank network.
problem: Food banks learn about crises only when lines grow.
solution: Monitors news and social signals, computes supply gaps per site, searches for emergency sources and generates fastest, cheapest and balanced plans.
demo_moment: Team-described: a detected crisis triggers three response plans.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Hex API” among 212 submissions.
The team volunteered at food banks.

lessons: Offer several plans with clear trade-offs.
